title: ChangesetSpec
description: Sourcegull changeset spec: one changeset to create from a branch, or an existing changeset to import. The two shapes are told apart by the presence of externalID.

baseRepository.description: GraphQL ID of the repository the changeset belongs to.

externalID.description: ID of the changeset on the code host (the merge request IID on GitLab).

baseRepository.description: GraphQL ID of the repository the changeset proposes to change.

baseRef.description: Full ref the changeset targets, e.g. refs/heads/main.

baseRev.description: Commit of baseRef the changes were computed against.

headRepository.description: GraphQL ID of the repository holding the head ref; must equal baseRepository (forks are chosen with fork).

headRef.description: Full ref the commits are pushed to, e.g. refs/heads/my-change.

fork.description: Push to a fork; overrides the site's enforceForks setting.

commits.description: The commit pushed to headRef (exactly one).

version.description: 2: diff is base64 (binary diffs allowed); otherwise diff is text.

published.description: true, false or "draft"; null or omitted leaves publication to the UI.
